ai.module.description: Cluster-level module manifest for ERCOT Houston Metro. Covers 10 facilities including AT&T metro nodes, Lumen transport hubs, regional enterprise industrial compute, and telecom fiber exchange. Includes RTT operator scores, drift/coherence envelopes, facility list, and navigation pointers.

cluster_mapping.cluster.name: Houston Metro
cluster_mapping.cluster.notes: Strong industrial adjacency; large metro fiber footprint; energy-sector compute presence; incremental compute growth driven by industrial corridor.
